name: Afterburner
description: Runs deferred/background work in parallel PHP workers using Spatie Async, driven from Drush and the kernel terminate event.
project_description: Afterburner is a performance module that brings true concurrency to Drupal background and queue processing by integrating Spatie's Async library to run tasks in parallel PHP worker processes. It provides an abstract TaskBase (a Spatie async Task that re-boots Drupal in the child process) and an abstract event-subscriber base (AfterburnerTasksSubscriberBase) that, on the kernel terminate event, spawns the Drush command afterburner:process-tasks to fan out a set of tasks across a worker pool with configurable concurrency, timeout and sleep time. The bundled afterburner_queue submodule adds a Drush command queue:run-async that claims items from a named Drupal queue and processes them in parallel via QueueItemTask. Afterburner is a developer framework: you subclass its bases to define which tasks run and when, rather than configuring it through a UI.
